summative_rubric.title: G1 CVC Decoders — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: Used during and after Lesson 5 to score against all 3 expectations.

rows.expectation_text: demonstrate phonemic awareness by manipulating individual phonemes in spoken words, including isolating, blending, segmenting, adding, deleting, and substituting phonemes

levels.descriptor: Cannot isolate or segment phonemes. Confuses letter names and sounds.
Isolates first sound with prompts. Segments 2 of 3 phonemes.
Independently isolates first and last sounds and segments CVC words into 3 phonemes.
Manipulates phonemes (substitutes, deletes) and explains the difference between letter name and sound.

rows.expectation_text: apply foundational knowledge of letter-sound correspondences, including consonant blends and digraphs, to read and spell unfamiliar words containing common spelling patterns

levels.descriptor: Says letter names instead of sounds. Cannot map letter to phoneme.
Maps some letters to sounds with prompts. Mixes name and sound.
Independently maps all single letters in a CVC word to their sounds. Builds CVC words.
Articulates name-vs-sound distinction and applies letter-sound knowledge to a new CVC pattern.

rows.expectation_text: decode unfamiliar words containing one syllable, including words with consonant blends, digraphs, and common vowel spelling patterns

levels.descriptor: Cannot decode CVC words. Stops at unknowns.
Decodes known CVC words with prompts. Choppy blending.
Independently decodes new CVC words by blending phonemes smoothly. Reads CVC words in connected sentences.
Re-reads for sense and self-corrects. Decodes a new sentence with at least one previously unseen CVC word.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Score during Lesson 5 capstone. Level 3 is the Grade 1 expectation.

summative_task_script.title: Big Decoder Capstone — Summative Administration Guide
summative_task_script.purpose: Ties Lesson 5 capstone, the 4 stations, and the rubric together.
administration_steps: Before: photocopy templates, print rubric, ready Junior Decoder certificates.
Stations 1-4 (~6-7 minutes each): HEAR, MAP, BLEND, READ.
Station 1 HEAR: segment 2 picture words. Evidence B2.1.
Station 2 MAP: 4 letter-to-sound matches. Evidence B2.2.
Station 3 BLEND: build and read 2 CVC words. Evidence B2.2 + B2.3.
Station 4 READ: decode 2 sentence strips, circle CVC words. Evidence B2.3.
After: review with each child briefly.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Use the Capstone Template as primary evidence. Level 3 is grade-level. Score within 24 hours of administration.

evidence_per_expectation.B2.2: Stations 2-3 — letter-sound match and word building.
evidence_per_expectation.B2.3: Stations 3-4 — blending and connected text reading.
